queries: recursive self improvement demonstration 2026 GPU AI 600 billion revenue

sources_considered.why: Read the abstract, then used the full paper to examine the experiment and hardware limitations.
Primary research describing repeated agent improvements, with relevant limits on model changes and hardware attribution.

evidence_items.explanation: The paper reports successive improvements to an agent's software while keeping its underlying models fixed. It identifies A100 evaluation hardware and does not establish attribution to the forecast's H100/B200/B300 deployments, so it is material contrary context rather than a decisive event.

unresolved_gaps: No verified self-improvement event tied to the specified deployments was established.
No matched measurement of $600 billion in additional existing-service revenue was found.
The forecast supplies no deadline or defined operational lifetime.
The digital-God limb has no testable standard.
